role: Project Area Committee / community planning body for Randolph Urban Renewal Area
stance_basis: RPSB co-developed the Randolph Plan through 24 months of joint planning, adopted it, and established the goals and objectives driving the project
summary: The Randolph Planning Study Board (RPSB) is the elected community planning body that co-developed the Randolph Urban Renewal Plan alongside the Richmond Redevelopment and Housing Authority over 24 months, ultimately adopting the plan. The RPSB established the community's goals and objectives for removing deficiencies, and the Regional Planning Commission specifically congratulated the RPSB on the excellence of the citizen-participation-driven plan. The RPSB is a proponent and co-author of the proposed action, not a critic.
complaint_summary: The RPSB, after 24 months of joint planning with the Richmond Redevelopment and Housing Authority to incorporate community goals and objectives, formally adopted the Randolph Plan, and the Regional Planning Commission unanimously approved it and congratulated the RPSB on the excellence of the citizen-participation process.
